> Can I use 2nd tradition, untap, and deflect or I should block?
>
> Thanks
> take
>

You must block, since card text does not allow otherwise:

The Second Tradition: Domain [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Reaction
Requires ready Prince or Justicar. {+2 intercept. Also usable by a tapped
Prince or Justicar, even if intercept is not yet needed, to untap and
attempt to block with +2 intercept}.

Of course, it is possible that the other Methuselah adds more stealth to the
action so that your block fails - in that case, you are left with an
untapped Pronce or Justicar, and that vampire can use other reaction cards
normally, e.g. bleed deflection.

--
